title: SimRec: Learning to Search, Ask, and Recommend from Simulated Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2611.15426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based recommendation agents can search catalogs, inspect products, ask users, and revise rejected recommendations. However, these behaviors are often governed by hand-designed workflows, while existing training methods optimize isolated components such as query rewriting or list ranking rather than the interaction policy as a whole. We present SimRec, a reinforcement learning framework that trains the full interaction policy of a tool-integrated recommendation agent. SimRec introduces two components. A task-anchored user simulator provides feedback on every recommendation: conditioned on the current task need rather than on user profile, and it can be an external LLM or the recommender itself under self-play. A task-aligned reward optimizes the whole trajectory with GRPO, crediting natural retrieval quality and valid tool use alongside the final hit, with training-only target injection to handle sparse hits over large catalogs. translated_title: SimRec：从模拟交互中学习搜索、提问与推荐
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐智能体能够搜索商品目录、查看产品信息、向用户提问，并在推荐被拒绝后进行修改。然而，这些行为通常由人工设计的流程所控制，而现有的训练方法往往只优化诸如查询重写或列表排序等孤立组件，而非整体的交互策略。我们提出了SimRec，一个用于训练工具集成推荐智能体完整交互策略的强化学习框架。SimRec引入了两个组件：其一是任务锚定的用户模拟器，它对每次推荐提供反馈——以当前任务需求而非用户画像为条件，既可以是外部LLM，也可以是自我博弈模式下的推荐器本身；其二是任务对齐的奖励，它利用GRPO优化整个轨迹，在考虑最终命中的同时，对自然检索质量和有效工具使用也给予信用奖励，并通过仅在训练阶段注入目标来应对大规模商品目录上的稀疏命中问题。在……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SimRec是一个强化学习框架，通过任务锚定的用户模拟器和覆盖整个轨迹的GRPO任务对齐奖励，端到端训练工具集成推荐智能体的完整交互策略，而非只优化查询重写、列表排序等孤立组件。
en_tdlr: SimRec is a reinforcement learning framework that trains the full interaction policy of a tool-integrated recommendation agent end-to-end, using a task-anchored user simulator and a task-aligned GRPO reward over the whole trajectory instead of optimizing isolated components.
